# CANDIDATE: VIX1D_RATIO_MEANREV_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When short-term VIX1D spikes relative to 30‑day VIX, dealer gamma hedging creates a temporary mean‑reversion tendency in SPY after an opening‑range expansion. The VIX1D/VIX_spot ratio > 1.25 signals elevated near-term fear disproportionate to longer-term volatility, creating a short-term overextension likely to revert.

## Mechanism

Entry: If VIX1D / VIX_spot > 1.25 AND price crosses below VWAP after the opening‑range high has been broken with a bearish candle (close < open) within the first 30 minutes of trading (09:30‑10:00 EST), then enter long at the close of that candle.  
Exit: Chart‑stop at the most recent swing low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off the high‑water mark.  
Regime filters: Only active when VIX spot > 15 and time between 09:45‑10:30 EST; skip FOMC days and major economic releases.
